How to Reach Guruvayur & Recommended Stays

Complete guide on rail connections, airports, taxi desks, and choosing the best hotel near East or West Nada.

Reaching Guruvayur

1. By Train (Railways)

Guruvayur Railway Station (Station Code: GUU): Located just 1.2 km from the temple (3–5 minutes by auto-rickshaw). Several passenger and express trains terminate here directly from Chennai, Trivandrum, and Ernakulam.

Thrissur Railway Station (Station Code: TCR): Located 28 km away, Thrissur is a major rail junction served by almost all major superfast and Rajdhani express trains. KSRTC buses run every 5 minutes from Thrissur to Guruvayur.

2. By Air (Flights)

Cochin International Airport (COK - Nedumbassery): Located 80 km away (~2 hours by taxi or direct KSRTC low-floor AC bus). Most convenient for domestic and international pilgrims.

Calicut International Airport (CCJ - Karipur): Located 85 km away (~2.5 hours by road via Ponnani/Chavakad).

Where to Stay in Guruvayur

East Nada (Kizhakkekotta)

Closest to the main temple gopuram, VIP lines, and Devaswom main booking counters. Ideal for families with elderly devotees who want walking access.

West Nada (Padinjarekotta)

Closer to Guruvayur railway station and KSRTC bus stand. Features larger hotels, spacious parking grounds, and peaceful ambiance away from main crowds.

Official Devaswom Guest Houses:

The Guruvayur Devaswom manages Panchajanyam, Kousthubham, and Sreevalsam guest houses. Advance online booking must be done strictly through guruvayurdevaswom.in.
